Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. Certifying the third-party integration required for this phase took longer than initially planned, which has moved our delivery date back by two weeks. We know timing matters for your own planning, and we wanted to flag this as soon as the revised schedule was confirmed.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team has already adjusted internal milestones to keep everything else on track, and we do not anticipate any further changes to this date based on what we know now.

Does this revised date work with your internal plans, or are there any dependencies on your end we should account for before then? We're happy to walk through the updated schedule in more detail on a call if that would be helpful, and we'll keep you posted with any progress updates in the meantime.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
